app.title: OmniRoute Setup
welcome.title: Connect free AI services to OmniRoute
welcome.body: This helper connects the free plans of a few AI services to OmniRoute on your computer. At the end you get one address and one key that work in any AI tool.
welcome.howItWorks: You sign in to each service yourself. The helper never sees or stores your passwords. It only does the clicking around after you sign in, and it asks before changing anything in your accounts.
select.title: Choose services
select.body: Pick the services you want to connect. You can skip any of them later.
notice.title: Before you start
notice.limits: Free plans have limits, and each service can change or end them at any time.
notice.personal: Use these keys only for yourself. Don't share them or use them to offer a service to others; the services' terms forbid it.
notice.developer: These are developer services. You are signing up under each service's own terms (most require you to be 18 or older), and you're responsible for following them.
notice.oneAccount: One account per service. Don't create extra accounts to get more free usage.
provider.openrouter.blurb: Many models, some free. Sign in through OpenRouter's own approval page; no clicking around needed.
provider.groq.blurb: Fast free models. You create the key in your usual browser; the helper picks it up.
provider.openrouter.privacy: OpenRouter: many free models only work if you allow providers that may use your inputs for training. That's your choice. Change it at Settings → Privacy: {url}
provider.groq.privacy: Groq says it does not train on your inputs.
step.browser.OPEN_SIGNUP: Open the keys page in your browser
step.browser.CREATE_AND_CAPTURE: Sign in, create and copy the key
step.GOTO_KEYS: Go to the API keys page
hint.openrouter.CONFIRM_CREATE: The helper will open OpenRouter in your web browser. After you sign in and approve, OpenRouter creates a key named "{keyName}" in your account. OK?
hint.openrouter.CREATE_AND_CAPTURE: In your browser, sign in to OpenRouter and click Authorize. Then come back here.
hint.groq.browser: In your browser: sign in to Groq (any way you like), click Create API Key, name it "{keyName}", then click Copy.
hint.browser.watching: The helper picks up the key as soon as you copy it.
clipboard.ask: When you copy the new {provider} key in your browser, may the helper pick it up from the clipboard? It only looks while waiting here, only takes text that is exactly a {provider} key, and removes the key from the clipboard afterwards. Otherwise you paste it yourself.
hint.groq.WAIT_USER_AUTH: Please sign in or create your Groq account in this window, with your email or GitHub (Google sign-in is usually blocked here). If asked, complete the email or phone check yourself. Click "I'm done" when you're signed in.
hint.groq.CONFIRM_CREATE: Create a key named "{keyName}" in your Groq account?
hint.groq.CREATE_AND_CAPTURE: Creating the key… Don't close this window.
hint.REGISTER: Adding the key to OmniRoute and testing it…
hint.manual.openrouter: Do it by hand: open {keysUrl}, click Create Key, copy the key (it starts with sk-or-) and paste it below.
hint.manual.groq: Do it by hand: open {keysUrl}, click Create API Key, name it "{keyName}", copy the key (it starts with gsk_; it's shown only once) and paste it below.
btn.switch: Let the helper click for me (separate window)
reason.keyRejected: The service says this key isn't valid.
reason.network: Couldn't reach the service. Check your internet connection.
reason.validateUnexpected: The service gave an unexpected answer while checking the key.
reason.omniTestFailed: OmniRoute added the key but its test failed.
reason.elementNotFound: The page looks different than expected, so the helper can't continue automatically.
reason.keyNotFound: The helper couldn't read the new key from the page.
reason.notSignedIn: You don't seem to be signed in yet. Sign in in the service window, then try again.
flow.overlayMissing: The help panel isn't showing in the service window. Use the buttons here instead.
result.title: All set
result.noneConnected: No services were connected. You can run this helper again any time.
result.keyOnce: Copy the key now and keep it somewhere safe: OmniRoute shows it only once. Don't share it.
result.howToUse: In your AI tool, choose an "OpenAI-compatible" provider, paste the address and the key above, and use the model name free. It only uses free models: it tries them in order and moves to the next one when one runs out or fails.
result.cleanupQuestion: The helper kept a separate browser profile with your sign-ins to these services. Delete it now?
callback.done: Done. You can close this tab and go back to OmniRoute Setup.
callback.error: Something went wrong. Go back to OmniRoute Setup and try again.
starting.firstRun: The first start can take up to a minute while your computer checks the new files.
starting.failed: OmniRoute could not start. Try again; if it keeps failing, restart your computer.
starting.portInUse: Another program is using port {port}, which OmniRoute needs. Close that program and try again.
starting.filesMissing: OmniRoute's files are missing. (Developers: run npm run prepare:omniroute.)
starting.secretsUnreadable: This helper's saved settings can't be read on this computer account, so its OmniRoute data can't be opened. Nothing was deleted. If you moved to a new computer or user account, set up again from there.
starting.noMachineId: This computer's ID couldn't be read, so the helper can't connect to OmniRoute.
starting.authFailed: The helper couldn't sign in to its own OmniRoute. Try again.
starting.unreachable: OmniRoute started but isn't answering. Try again.
tray.stillRunning: OmniRoute keeps running in the background so your AI tools keep working. Click this icon to open it again.
autostart.label: Start in the background when your computer starts
autostart.why: Your AI tools only work while OmniRoute is running. With this on, they also work after a restart.
autostart.devOnly: Starting automatically with your computer is available in the installed app.
home.status.stopped: OmniRoute is stopped. Your AI tools can't use it right now.
home.keyHint: Use this address with the key you saved during setup and the model name free. Lost the key? Create a new one below.
home.service.inactive: added, but its last check failed
home.dashboardHint: For advanced settings. It asks for a password: copy it here, then paste it on the sign-in page.
free.noModels: No free models could be confirmed for your connected services right now, so no key was created. Check your internet connection and try again.
provider.openrouter.creditsWarning: Your OpenRouter account has bought credits, so it can be charged for paid models. Keys from this helper only use free models, but other apps using this account could spend them. To be safe, set a credit limit on the key at {url}.
notice.noCost: Keys from this helper can only use models that are free. If a model stops being free, it simply stops working; it never starts costing money.
free.connectFirst: Connect a service first ("Add services"). A key is only useful once there is something free to use with it.
